name: Super wide-range grid stack

source.label: The super wide-range grid stack strategy (Gainium blog, 2022)

rules: Take the coin's price range of the last two years and cut it into a bottom, middle and top third.
Add a zone below the range (down to half its low) and a zone above it (up to twice its high).
Run one grid bot per zone: 2.5% spacing outside the range, 1% in the bottom and top thirds, 1.5% in the middle.
Split the budget 5% below, 30% bottom, 20% middle, 30% top, 15% above.
Take profit in the coin in the lower three zones and in USDT in the upper two.
Start every grid at once and leave them running.
notExpressed: Fine-tuning zone edges to support and resistance by hand
Earning yield on the funds the grids are not using
